evidence.snippet: Generate OAuth client IDs and secrets immediately for development and testing.
all new applications created via the self-service tool will enter Demo Mode by default.
When you are ready to take your integration live, simply request a review directly from the app details page in your dashboard.

decisions.reason: Credentials can be self-generated for dev/testing, but production (live) use requires a vendor review to exit Demo Mode, matching the app_review definition rather than fully free self-serve.
